article.headline: Russell Westbrook Retires After 18 Seasons: The All-Time Triple-Double King Walks Away on His Own Terms

research.facts:
Russell Westbrook Retires After 18 Seasons
**Sources:**
- NBC Sports (official retirement announcement)
- NBA.com (retirement news)
- Yahoo Sports (retirement article)
- ESPN (legacy story)
- Al Jazeera, Chicago Sun-Times, Hoops Rumors
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Westbrook announced retirement via video narrated by actor Michael B. Jordan
- 18 NBA seasons total
- 9x NBA All-Star, 9x All-NBA selection
- 2017 NBA Most Valuable Player (Oklahoma City Thunder)
- NBA all-time leader in triple-doubles: **209** (surpassed Oscar Robertson)
- First player since Oscar Robertson in 1962 to average a triple-double for a full season (2016-17)
- 5th all-time in NBA assists: 10,351
- 14th all-time in NBA scoring: 27,176 points
- Teams: Thunder, Rockets, Wizards, Lakers, Clippers, Nuggets, Kings
- Offered minimum contracts by Kings and Wizards this offseason
- Chose to retire rather than continue as a reserve
**Verified Facts (MEDIUM confidence):**
- Michael B. Jordan narrated the retirement announcement video (per prior pipeline note Aug 13)
